name: US equity stress
summary: VIX closed near 35.9 on 20 Nov, its 52-week high and above the 30 Alert line; S&P 500 11.6% below its high
state: The VIX closed near 35.9 on Friday 20 Nov, its 52-week high and above the 30 Alert line, after rising 57% over the week (Yahoo Finance). The S&P 500 closed near 6,910, 6.8% lower on the week and 11.6% below its 52-week high, inside the 15% drawdown line, so the Alert rests on volatility. US markets reopen on 23 Nov; no circuit breaker has tripped.
for_you: US shares are in a high-volatility stress regime. Pension and investment values linked to equities can swing sharply from day to day while volatility stays this high.
why: The S&P 500 is the world's risk barometer; sharp falls and spiking volatility transmit to pensions, credit and confidence globally.
drivers: Earnings, interest-rate expectations, liquidity, geopolitical shocks, positioning and leverage.

rubric.alert: VIX > 30, or drawdown > 15%, or a market-wide circuit breaker trips.
rubric.normal: VIX < 20 and S&P 500 drawdown from 52-week high < 5%.
